caption:
The rain in Neo-Berlin doesn't wash away the grime; it just makes the neon glow smear against the wet pavement like oil on a canvas. 🍂✨

I can feel the bite of the synthetic autumn air against my skin, but the heat radiating from the hidden alcove is enough to keep me warm. My boots click rhythmically against the metal grating, each step a calculated risk. I'm here for the 'Ghost Drive,' but the way my heart hammers against my ribs has nothing to do with data.

I saw him waiting in the shadows. As he stepped forward, the air between us crackled with more than just static electricity. I leaned in, my breath hitching, my skin prickling under my leather gear. 

"You have it?" I whispered, my voice low and heavy.

He didn't answer. He just looked at me, his cybernetic eyes flickering with a faint, predatory blue hue. I reached out, my fingers grazing the cold metal of his gauntlet, then moving upward to the warm skin of his neck. A jolt of pure, unfiltered electricity shot through my veins. My pulse quickened, my chest heaving slightly as I pulled him closer into the damp shadows. It’s dangerous, it’s reckless, and it’s the only thing that makes me feel alive in this chrome graveyard. The deal can wait. Right now, the only thing I want to explore is the friction between us. 🌃🔥
